title: PELDRUN Skill Catalog
description: JSON Schema for the remote skill catalog consumed by PELDRUN via PELDRUN_SKILL_CATALOG_URL. Mirrors omweb.skills.catalog.schema.SkillCatalogItem (Pydantic v2), excluding the computed fields installable / installability_reason which are added by the backend at load time.

schema_version.description: Catalog format version. Currently only 1 is supported.

description.description: Human-readable description of the catalog's purpose.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last catalog update. Informational only.

id.description: Canonical skill identifier. Must match the skill package's manifest.id. Lowercase, snake_case, 3-64 chars.

display_name.description: Human-friendly name shown in the UI. Falls back to `name` when null or omitted.

description.description: One-line summary shown on the catalog card.

version.description: Semantic version. Must match the skill package's manifest.version.

download_url.description: HTTPS URL of the skill ZIP archive. Required for installability. When null, the item is preview-only.

checksum_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the ZIP at download_url. Required for installability. When null, the item is preview-only.

brand_color.description: Primary brand color as 6-digit hex (e.g. '#8B5CF6'). Rendered as the skill card's left-border accent. Propagated to manifest.json at install time so the installed card matches the catalog card.

icon.description: Icon name (when icon_type='name') or full inline SVG markup (when icon_type='svg').

author.description: Publisher name (flat, for backward compatibility with older catalogs). Prefer `developer` for richer metadata.

developer.description: Structured publisher metadata. Rendered as a rich block in the details modal when present.

tags.description: Free-form tags used for filtering in the store UI.

has_sub_skills.description: True when the skill declares a `sub_skills` array (router pattern). Drives the ROUTER badge on the card.

sub_skills_count.description: Number of sub-skills declared. Must be > 0 when has_sub_skills is true, and 0 otherwise.

trust.description: Publisher trust tier. `verified` renders a shield badge.

stability.description: Lifecycle stability tier. Deprecated items still render but warn.

install_warnings.description: Advisory strings shown in the install confirmation dialog (e.g. 'This skill requires Progressive Disclosure.').
